- cancellationRequests → IShoppingMallCancellationRequest.ISummary[] from shopping_mall_cancellation_requests where shopping_mall_order_item_id matches, filter deleted_at IS NULL
- refundRequests → IShoppingMallRefundRequest.ISummary[] from shopping_mall_refund_requests where shopping_mall_order_item_id matches, filter deleted_at IS NULL

IShoppingMallProduct.IDetail.description:
Comprehensive product detail page data aggregating product information, category, seller profile, image gallery, purchasable variants with stock status, customer reviews, and computed rating statistics.

This type is the response for the customer product detail endpoint. It combines product metadata with all related entities needed to render a complete product detail page.

Product fields include the name, description, and base price — the base price serves as the default, with individual variants potentially overriding it.

Relations include the product's category (name and identifier), the seller's shop profile (shop name and logo), the complete image gallery in display order, all available variants with their option values, prices, and current stock quantities, and all published reviews with reviewer attribution and computed aggregate rating.
IShoppingMallProduct.IDetail.x-autobe-specification: Primary: shopping_mall_products (id, name, description, base_price, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). JOIN shopping_mall_categories via shopping_mall_category_id for category ISummary (id, name). JOIN shopping_mall_seller_profiles via shopping_mall_seller_id for seller ISummary (shop_name, logo_image_uri). Load shopping_mall_product_images ordered by display_order ASC for images array. Load non-deleted shopping_mall_product_variants (deleted_at IS NULL) with child shopping_mall_product_variant_option_values for variants array; stock computed by summing shopping_mall_inventory_records.quantity_change per variant. Load non-deleted shopping_mall_review_reviews (deleted_at IS NULL) ordered by created_at DESC for reviews array; JOIN shopping_mall_customers via shopping_mall_customer_id for reviewer display_name (show 'deleted user' if customer soft-deleted). Compute average_rating: mean of all non-deleted review ratings, rounded to 1 decimal, null if none. Compute review_count: count of non-deleted reviews. Compute is_available: true when product has at least one non-deleted variant.

variant_id.description:
The unique identifier of the product variant to purchase.

References a specific SKU variant from the product catalog. The variant must exist, not be soft-deleted, and have sufficient stock to fulfill the requested quantity.

Stock availability is validated server-side during checkout — if any variant is out of stock or has insufficient quantity, the entire order is rejected.
variant_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_order_items.shopping_mall_product_variant_id. BELONGS-TO FK referencing shopping_mall_product_variants.id. The variant must exist, not be soft-deleted (deleted_at IS NULL), and have sufficient stock (derived from SUM of shopping_mall_inventory_records.quantity for that variant). Stock validation is performed server-side during checkout — if any variant is out of stock or has insufficient quantity, the entire order is rejected.

quantity.description:
The number of units of this variant to purchase.

Must be a positive integer of at least 1. When the same variant is added to the cart multiple times, quantities combine into a single order item at checkout rather than creating separate line items.

The system validates that the requested quantity does not exceed available stock. If the requested quantity exceeds the current stock level for the variant, the entire order is rejected.
quantity.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to shopping_mall_order_items.quantity. Must be a positive integer of at least 1. When the same variant is added to the cart multiple times, quantities combine into a single order item at checkout rather than creating separate line items. The system validates that the requested quantity does not exceed available stock (derived from SUM of shopping_mall_inventory_records.quantity for that variant, subtracting any pending order holds).

IShoppingMallOrderItem.ICreate.description:
A single item to purchase within a new order.

Identifies a specific product variant by its unique identifier and the desired quantity. Each entry in the order's items array becomes an individual order item with its own lifecycle status, starting as "paid" after successful payment processing.

The system validates stock availability for every requested variant before processing. The unit price is computed server-side from the variant's current price at checkout — the client must not submit a price. On successful payment, the system atomically creates the order item, captures product, variant, and seller snapshots, deducts inventory, and removes the purchased items from the customer's cart.
IShoppingMallOrderItem.ICreate.x-autobe-specification:
Direct mapping for user-provided fields: quantity → shopping_mall_order_items.quantity (positive integer, min 1). Reference: variant_id → shopping_mall_order_items.shopping_mall_product_variant_id (BELONGS-TO FK to shopping_mall_product_variants.id). The variant must exist, not be soft-deleted (deleted_at IS NULL), and have sufficient stock (derived from SUM of shopping_mall_inventory_records.quantity for that variant).

Excluded from ICreate: id (auto-generated UUID on creation), shopping_mall_order_id (parent context from the wrapping IShoppingMallOrder.ICreate), price (server-computed from variant's current price or product base price at checkout — client must never submit a price), status (always 'paid' on order creation, set server-side), shopping_mall_shipment_id (assigned later during shipment creation), created_at and updated_at (system-managed timestamps). All belongs-to relations (order, productVariant, shipment) and has-many/has-one relations (cancellationRequests, refundRequests, productSnapshot, variantSnapshot, sellerSnapshot, reviews) are server-managed or belong to different lifecycle stages and are excluded from this DTO.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the product snapshot record.

The primary key, automatically generated as a UUID when the snapshot is created at order placement time. This identifier is immutable and serves as the canonical reference for retrieving the full snapshot.

name.description:
Product name as it appeared at the time of order placement.

Preserved verbatim from the original product regardless of later edits, ensuring historical accuracy in order records. This is the display name the customer saw when making the purchase.

description.description:
Product description as it appeared at the time of order placement.

Captures the full descriptive text from the original product at purchase time. Preserved for historical accuracy even if the seller later updates or removes the product description.

basePrice.description:
Base price of the product at the time of order placement.

Preserved in the original currency unit. This is the product-level base price, distinct from the variant-specific price recorded in the variant snapshot. Frozen at order time and never updated, it provides the authoritative price reference for historical order display.

categoryName.description:
Denormalized category name at the time of order placement.

Preserved for historical accuracy even if the referenced category is later renamed, restructured, or deleted by administrators. Provides a direct human-readable category label without requiring a join to the categories table.

createdAt.description:
Timestamp when this snapshot was created.

Corresponds to the order creation time. Immutable — set once at order placement and never changed. All snapshot data reflects the product state at this exact point in time.

IShoppingMallOrderItemProductSnapshot.IS.description:
Summary representation of an order item product snapshot for display in nested contexts.

Captures the essential frozen product data — name, description, base price, and category name — as they existed at the moment of order placement. This summary provides a lightweight reference to the product snapshot without including the full image gallery or back-references to original entities.

Each field is preserved verbatim from the original product at purchase time and is immutable. Even if the seller later modifies or deletes the original product, this summary remains an authoritative historical record of what the customer saw when placing the order.
